name: What a $99 Move-In Special Actually Means
seo-title: $99 Move-In Special: What It Means | brightplace
meta-description: A $99 move-in special caps your upfront cost, not your rent. What the $99 covers, the clawback clause to check, and how each special type compares.
focus-keyword: what does a $99 move in special mean
post-summary: A $99 move-in special means you pay $99 to take possession of the apartment, and that flat fee replaces your security deposit and first month's rent combined. It does not reduce your monthly rent. Full rent begins in month two, and nearly every $99 offer requires a 12-month lease, clean rental
